title: Playboy Special Editions Lot of 4 Playmate Review Girls + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage magazines in good overall condition for their age. Covers show normal storage and handling wear, including some scuffs, edge/corner wear and minor creasing. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as pictured.

Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy special-edition magazines.

Includes:

* Playboy’s Nudes — “Naughty But Nice” holiday/Christmas issue
* Playboy’s Playmate Review — Eighth Annual, 112-page roundup
* Playboy’s Playmate Review — Sixth Annual, 112-page roundup
* Playboy’s Girls of Summer ’92 — “Girl-Watching Made Easy”

All 4 magazines shown are included and sold together as one lot.

Nice assortment of vintage Playboy special editions featuring two different annual Playmate Review issues along with the Girls of Summer ‘92 and Playboy’s Nudes special editions.

Great for collectors of vintage Playboy publications, men’s magazines, glamour photography and Playboy memorabilia.

These are vintage pre-owned magazines and may have age-related shelf and handling wear. Please use the photos as the primary reference for condition and exactly what is included.

Quantity: 4 magazines

Publisher: Playboy

Format: Magazine / Special Edition

Language: English

Genre: Men’s Interest / Photography / Collectibles

Era: Vintage

Sale: Lot of 4 + 1
